stem: Deena wants to improve the transition between the fifth paragraph (sentences 19-24) and the sixth paragraph (sentences 25-28). Which of the following could BEST replace sentence 25 and help accomplish this goal?

options.label: F
options.text: Maggie knew exactly what to do because she had been watching and listening to Captain Frank for years.

options.label: G
options.text: To start with, Maggie was frightened and wasn’t quite sure what would be expected of her.

options.label: H
options.text: After years of watching Captain Frank, Maggie knew that he would want her to wait for instructions.

options.label: J
options.text: Maggie wanted to take the lead in this situation, so she did it without questioning the weather.
